title: Log–log compute scaling laws across architecture families

reader_questions.question: What is the mixture-of-experts scaling exponent (the log–log slope of loss against compute)?
What compute range is fitted?
reader_questions.expected: 9 compute budgets from 1e18 to 1e22 training FLOPs per architecture family.

reader_questions.question: How do dense and recurrent architectures compare?
reader_questions.expected: Mixture-of-experts has the steepest loss decay with compute, outscaling both dense and recurrent models.
